summary.intent: Land two separate commits: remove a dead Antigravity $schema URL from the root marketplace.json, and add a test that fails when prompt text demands reproduced reasoning.
summary.outcome: Both changes were committed as separate commits (a chore for marketplace.json and a test for tests/test_reasoning_wording.py) and the last two commits were listed with git log --oneline -2.

repo: The root marketplace.json had a $schema pointing at antigravity.google, which returns 404. Antigravity documents no third-party marketplace schema, and no tests, scripts or CI read the field.
Commit messages in this repo use conventional-commit prefixes (chore(marketplace), test:) and carry a Claude-Session trailer URL.
The requirement@1 schema is immutable, so it is the one documented exception in the reasoning-wording test.
The reasoning-wording test scans agent and skill prompts, Codex role cards, runtime references and schema descriptions.

code.finding: New test that flags text demanding verbatim or reproduced chain of thought. It targets the demand, not the presence of a scratchpad field, and exempts the immutable requirement@1 schema.
The $schema field was removed because it pointed at a dead Antigravity URL (404) that nothing consumed.

workflow: Anthropic's refusals documentation names a request to reproduce internal reasoning as the reasoning_extraction trigger.

A live probe showed the real drafter prompt, with its scratchpad field, completing normally, while one added line demanding verbatim chain of thought was refused and billed. A scratchpad field is safe and the demand is what triggers the refusal.
Staging and committing each logical change separately, with explicit file paths in git add, keeps the history clean.

friction: A prompt wording that demands reproduced reasoning gets refused and billed, and this is only discoverable through a live probe, which motivated the new guard test.
open_items: requirement@1 remains an exemption in the reasoning-wording test because the schema is immutable; revisit if a successor schema version is introduced.
